scope: Local Oireachtas query planning; Stage A, Stage B and Stage C plans use one shared typed v2 envelope with closed family-specific semantic projections.

interpretationPolicy.scope: Unqualified present-tense TD representation of a grounded named constituency, optionally filtered by a named party, defaults to asOf except that the non-party one-term Member/constituency projection treats explicit 'in this Dáil' as term-wide regardless of verb tense. Not historical, future/conditional, election, Seanad or unrelated intent.
interpretationPolicy.planEvidence: Optional top-level interpretation object with exactly policy, original question and date equal to asOf. Deterministic code creates and revalidates this evidence, never the model. Explicit term/date takes precedence; in the non-party Member/constituency projection, 'in this Dáil' is explicit term-wide scope unless an explicit current-point or exact-date membership condition is also requested. Unsupported extra date filters are refused rather than defaulted.
interpretationPolicy.execution: Current term must be selected uniquely from House-owned dating evidence. Both representation and any political-affiliation episode independently contain asOf; historical overlap alone is insufficient.
interpretationPolicy.partyListingScope: dail_parties_and_groups family_result may carry includeGroups Boolean; omitted means true for legacy plans. False suppresses irrelevant group-coverage warnings, not party evidence safeguards.
interpretationPolicy.memberAliasEvidence: Exact NFC/case-insensitive local foaf:name or exact source agents:pId spelling after removing user whitespace only. No nickname dictionary, accent folding, approximate name merge or manufactured IRI. Duplicate identities remain ambiguous. SPARQL LCASE is a prefilter; Python rechecks NFC/casefold equality.

relations.note: Fixed Government IRI is referenced only in the Member-owned Cabinet triple; Government descriptions are not Member-owned and no Government owner graph is required. Target is the enduring constitutional Government institution already referenced by the Member ETL, not GovernmentExecutive.

relations.note: Legacy plan fact identifier retained for compatibility; association requires the explicit RDF path, not co-containment.
The typed Work constraint is family-specific and requires the reviewed ExplanatoryMemo -> LegalExpression -> Format rendition chain.

capabilities.semantics: Ground exact full-name or whole-name-token partial mentions without assuming a full name. Deputy/TD requires recorded DailMembership; Senator requires Seanad service. Distinct people remain candidates. An opaque choice resumes this same validated lookup after rechecking source identities.
List recorded ParliamentaryParty identities in exactly one explicitly numbered Dáil using the existing term-scoped compiler. Only report missing ParliamentaryGroup data if groups were requested.

Resolve one exact Member and one reviewed NamedOffice identity, then return every locally recorded accepted OfficeHolding episode for that exact pair with its exact validated interval using complete bounded pagination. Accept only an unfiltered when/date/period question, 'When did [member] serve as [office]?', or 'During what period was [member] [office]?'. Missing, conflicting, malformed, or uncertain accepted interval evidence fails closed for the whole projection. The result is explicitly incomplete local-recorded episodes, not a complete career/tenure history; do not infer first start, final end, total duration, a single merged tenure, or absence from gaps. Unreviewed observations are not OfficeHolding evidence. Election-event and duration questions or extra filters remain unsupported.

Reuse accepted dated OfficeHolding overlap for an explicit calendar-date point, full calendar month, full calendar year, explicit month-to-month window, or a date-less present/current named-office question whose local executor injects configured asOf as one inclusive calendar-date point. The planner must not invent that date. Date and calendar-window semantics remain distinct; a partial-window match is not service throughout. Preserve exact accepted holding intervals and fail closed on missing/conflicting/uncertain evidence; absent matches do not imply no holder. A current-point result is only locally evidenced holdings and never certifies a complete current-office roster.
Return the earliest evidenced Seanad membership start date and preserve later distinct Seanad episodes. This does not answer Dáil service or a Seanad representation question.

Resolve one exact Bill identity by its explicitly supplied number and legislative year. Return the existing lookup projection: English title, mapped process status, official link, every locally recorded typed dated activity, and only a complete typed explanatory-memorandum rendition chain. Dated activity coverage is not certified complete; do not substitute sponsorship, voting, or a predicted next step.

Q23 is owned by the integrated composable /ask route and reuses the validated Bill-owned sponsor Participation path and existing presentation. Return distinct Bills with English short titles and primary/supporting/unknown evidence. Its bounded count projection may add one exact Published-activity calendar-year constraint and counts distinct Bill IRIs only after the same sponsorship selection and fail-closed temporal evidence evaluation; this does not create a general Bill query framework.

seanadPartySelection.presentDefault: Only unqualified present-tense named-party Senator questions default to currentTerm; local interpretation policy present_seanad_party_as_of records the question and configured date. Explicit historical terms/dates never default.
seanadPartySelection.current: House-owned date resolution selects one current SeanadTerm. Exact typed SeanadMembership and its exact containing PartyMembership episode must both independently contain asOf inclusively.
seanadPartySelection.numbered: Resolve one exact typed SeanadTerm by mapped integer termNo. Reuse the Stage C term-scoped party gate and reviewed PoliticalAffiliationIdentity; require inclusive validated overlap between each exact SeanadMembership and linked PartyMembership episode. No present-day substitution. Preserve separate party changes/episodes before distinct Member deduplication.
seanadPartySelection.evidence: Preserve Member, term, membership, party, affiliation and episode identities and separate source intervals. Complete bounded pagination is required; missing/conflicting interval or identity evidence fails closed, no local match is not a certified historical negative, and local roster completeness is not certified. Party mentions may omit the terminal generic word Party from a whole reviewed name; resolution remains term-scoped and ambiguous matches are never collapsed (Labour does not match National Labour Party).
seanadPartySelection.unsupported: Additional dates, conflicting terms, panels, offices, committees, exclusions, simultaneous service and other unrepresented conditions fail closed.

identitySet.semantics: Finite OR of explicit exact mentions resolved independently in one selected DailTerm. One VALUES identity set, Member-identity deduplication; no substring-inferred geographic sets.

sharedResource.semantics: At most one named anchor and one answer Member, independent DailMembership paths to the same exact DailConstituency and DailTerm resources, distinct Member identities. In the bounded term-wide co-membership projection, resolve the anchor representation uniquely in that term and exclude the anchor by exact Member IRI; do not imply simultaneous service.

commonIntersection.semantics: Nonempty inclusive intersection of accepted anchor OfficeHolding, anchor DailMembership, answer DailMembership and its exact PartyMembership episode. Reuse mapped xsd:dateTime evidence, absent end open-ended, missing/conflicting range or start uncertain. Preserve all episode/interval evidence; partial accepted-evidence coverage only.

member_relationship_composition.semantics: Count distinct Member RDF identities from the same validated one-term/one-constituency selection as its Member list, including one uniquely House-date-resolved current Dáil. In this non-party projection, the explicit phrase 'in this Dáil' selects that exact current term term-wide, retaining all recorded term memberships regardless of whether the question says 'represent' or 'represented'; it overrides the implicit present-tense asOf default. Explicit current-point wording (currently/now/today or as of now/today) independently requires DailMembership date evidence containing asOf. An explicitly supplied calendar date remains its exact membership-date point. Dated party/representation composition retains its separate current-term rule. A named-party count without a constituency is supported only for one explicitly numbered Dáil: reuse the accepted Stage C term-scoped ParliamentaryParty listing as a gate, join the exact PartyMembership to the same DailMembership and exact reviewed PoliticalAffiliationIdentity, and validate inclusive interval overlap before deduplicating Member IRIs. The separate current-Seanad/prior-Dáil projection counts distinct Member identities only after the same exact current-membership, finite-endpoint, strict-chronology and complete-pagination checks as its list. Incomplete, ambiguous, conflicting, capped or truncated evidence returns no count. Counts are not seats/election totals and do not certify roster completeness. Other temporal party/representation counts remain unsupported.

anchoredSharedConstituencyProjection.identityJoin: Independent anchor and answer DailMembership paths share the exact same DailTerm and DailConstituency IRIs, with the constituency occurrence linked to the selected term.
anchoredSharedConstituencyProjection.anchor: Resolve one exact local Member identity and exactly one accepted constituency identity in the selected term; exclude the anchor by Member IRI.
anchoredSharedConstituencyProjection.answer: Distinct other Member IRIs using the same complete bounded selection for list and count.
anchoredSharedConstituencyProjection.timeMeaning: Term-wide recorded co-membership, not necessarily simultaneous service.
anchoredSharedConstituencyProjection.uncertainOrConflictingEvidence: Fail closed; no partial answer or inferred negative.

questionFamilies.semantics: Return recorded constitutional Government members of an exactly resolved enduring party identity at asOf. Require CabinetMembership and PartyMembership intervals containing the same reference date, plus containing parliamentary membership and HouseTerm date evidence. Minister-of-State-only cases and GovernmentExecutive are not Cabinet membership. Preserve source episodes and explicitly state that incomplete current-office/party coverage is not a complete Government roster; no matches is not a certified empty roster.

Project a named Member's current or career-wide constituency occurrences with their exact Dáil terms, or return current TDs for one named constituency. Current Dáil is uniquely resolved from House-owned term dates at asOf, never an ordinal. Current membership requires its own mapped date interval spanning asOf, within that term. Historical answers preserve term-scoped constituency identities. No source completeness claim is implied.
Grounded name tokens resolve to zero, one, or a set of distinct local Member IRIs; ambiguity is not collapsed.
Previous Dáil is selected from HouseTerm start/end evidence relative to explicit asOf; membership is tested in that term.
Cumulative service is the union of dated membership intervals through asOf; gaps are preserved and open ends are not unbounded.
Count distinct HouseTerm resource identities, never membership rows or replacement people.
Earliest dated Seanad membership and later episodes remain distinct; representation is displayed only as the source-provided designation.
Dated collection membership is evaluated at asOf; IndependentMemberCollection is a parliamentary status, not a political party.
Report the term-scoped mapped representation resource/designation without coercing panel, university constituency, or an unmapped Taoiseach nomination category into one another.
Unscoped committee names default to a uniquely evidenced incarnation current at asOf; absent/ambiguous current-date evidence is unavailable, not yes/no.
Count distinct Committee IRI identities, not repeated CommitteeMembership records.

Chronological House-owned start/end evidence distinguishes a current open term from an unclassified missing end. Date-point and full-month selection preserve the original time scope and every selected exact term identity; term existence is not evidence of a sitting.
Set-valued exact-name resolution returns every distinct Member identity with DáilMembership evidence.
Resolve a supplied title mention; the approved AI abbreviation expands to Artificial Intelligence; retain multiple distinct Bill identities as candidates and never choose by guess.
Use any typed BillActivity with exact Published type and mapped xsd:date in the requested calendar year; legislativeYear is not a publication-date fallback.
Include every known status other than Enacted, report grouped local counts, and fail closed on missing or conflicting process statuses.
Resolve the supplied Bill title mention; report source-backed status and queryable dated lifecycle activities, never infer a next step.
Return all Bill-owned Participation records including unknown primary and role-only evidence; Member labels join only by exact RDF IRI through the reviewed Member owner graph.

Resolve one exact Member IRI, traverse BillDelivery created_a_realization_of Bill and forms_part_of the same Bill-owned LegislativeProcess containing sponsor Participations, and join participant-person only by exact Member RDF identity. Return distinct Bill IRIs and preserve all participation role/primary evidence. The bounded count projection additionally requires source-backed typed Published activities with valid xsd:date dates in exactly one calendar year, deduplicates by Bill identity, and fails closed for missing/unavailable evidence; it never uses legislative year or version/document dates.

Resolve exact Bill number/year; display English title, mapped status, official link, available dated activity evidence, and only typed explanatory-memorandum rendition chains recorded in the same Bill-owned graph.
Resolve a uniquely dated current Committee owner first; report chair evidence gap because no chair/office-holder predicate is queryable; do not infer from membership.
Report the reviewed development source conflict/quarantine as a coverage failure, not a planning failure or current roster.

Reuse the accepted inclusive calendar-window OfficeHolding path; resolve the named Member to one exact local Member IRI, bind the Member referent by identity (never display label), and show tenure start/end evidence.
Require complete current coverage; the incomplete development holding sample and office aliases do not establish a current holder.
Reuse accepted inclusive calendar-date OfficeHolding evidence for the requested point date.
Resolve one typed DailTerm by its exact numeric term ordinal and report its authoritative agents:seats value; never count Member records.

Resolve one typed DailTerm first, then list term-scoped ParliamentaryParty records for that exact identity, preserving rows with missing labels; separately report ParliamentaryGroup coverage as missing because no current group instances are emitted.
Check only the exact Bill-owned graph for 2024/48; an absent graph is explained by the reviewed source quarantine, not ordinary title-resolution failure or proof of nonexistence.
Reuse the reviewed actual-sitting to produced DebateRecord path and graph-route chamber identity; local absence is not a claim that no debate occurred.
Resolve the reviewed alias PAC to Committee of Public Accounts, but do not infer substantive HSE examination or latest coverage from the pinned metadata-only hearing.
Bill-linked voting is unavailable; sponsorship participation is not voting evidence.
Transcript speech content is unavailable because no approved transcript retrieval path exists; Debate metadata and links are not speech content.

Select one current DailTerm and one current SeanadTerm independently from House-owned dates at asOf, then intersect exact Member identities across separate DailMembership and SeanadMembership paths to those exact term IRIs. The result means recorded membership in each current term; display each mapped interval as evidence but do not require overlap or claim simultaneous/current service. Missing, conflicting, capped or truncated term, identity or membership-interval evidence fails closed; local historical completeness is not certified.

Resolve exactly one current SeanadTerm from Houses-owned dates at asOf, then join exact Member identities through independent typed SeanadMembership and DailMembership paths to typed HouseTerm identities. A SeanadMembership qualifies only when its own accepted inclusive interval contains asOf. A DailMembership is prior evidence only when its accepted EndDate is finite and strictly earlier than the StartDate of that same qualifying SeanadMembership; equal endpoints and open-ended Dáil intervals do not qualify, and ordinal ordering is not a substitute. Preserve both membership and term identities and intervals. List and distinct Member count share complete bounded pagination and interval validation. Missing, conflicting, malformed, capped or truncated identity/date evidence fails closed. Report positive local matches only; local historical completeness is not certified and an absent path is not proof that a person never served.

Resolve the current SeanadTerm from House-owned dates at asOf. Select term-scoped ParliamentaryParty and exact reviewed PoliticalAffiliationIdentity records; join each typed PartyMembership episode to its exact SeanadMembership. Both the SeanadMembership-owned interval and PartyMembership-owned interval must independently contain asOf using inclusive endpoints. The Member list and distinct-identity count use the same fully paginated selection; missing/conflicting identity or interval evidence and capped/truncated pages fail closed. Local current roster completeness is not certified.

Resolve exactly two Member identities independently. Each must have its own DailMembership linked to the same shared DailTerm RDF identity. Return the intersection by that shared resource identity; label equality is not a join. This family does not imply complete historical source coverage or support additional filters, temporal constraints, Seanad terms, or other relationships.

Return distinct identities by joining typed Member relationship paths to exact HouseTerm resource identities. Supports: (1) one Member with membership in each of exactly two explicitly numbered Dáil terms; (2) Members whose membership represents one named constituency occurrence in exactly one explicitly numbered Dáil term; and (3) those constituency representatives with PartyMembership episodes linked to the exact same OireachtasMembership, term-scoped ParliamentaryParty and reviewed PoliticalAffiliationIdentity, either during one explicitly numbered Dáil or at the reference date in the uniquely date-resolved current Dáil. For (3), the PartyMembership-owned date interval must overlap the containing DailMembership-owned representation interval using inclusive xsd:dateTime endpoints; when currentTerm is selected, both intervals must independently contain asOf as well. An absent EndDate is open-ended, while an absent range/start or invalid/conflicting dates makes temporal evaluation uncertain and the answer fails closed. Only typed PartyMembership episodes count; Independent collection membership is not a political party. The party/representation join is by exact RDF identities, never label equality or undated/current-affiliation shortcuts. The declared bounded compositionOperators additionally permit a finite constituency identity OR set, or independent anchor/answer Member paths sharing exact constituency and term resources with distinct Members and a common accepted-office/representation/party interval intersection. The latter needs no guessed numbered-term selector and preserves partial accepted-evidence coverage. Other filters, calendar-window operators, Seanad relations, or source-completeness claims are not implied.

constraints.meaning: Bind the person-role Member referent to the exact resolved local Member IRI; labels are display-only and cannot satisfy identity.

constraints.semantics: Filter on source-backed dated Published lifecycle activities in the requested calendar year; never use legislative year or document/version dates. Missing or malformed event dates are uncertain evidence, not a non-match.

answer.supportingEvidence: distinct relationship episodes; preserve separate dated records and Bill sponsorship participations before Bill-identity deduplication

countProjection.selectionParity: same validated bounded Member selection and temporal evaluator as entity listing
countProjection.qualification: recorded Member count; never a seat allocation or election-event count

temporalCompositionProjection.unknownDates: never treated as overlap or non-overlap; fail closed

termSelection.month: full first-to-last-day interval; select exact HouseTerm identities whose House-owned interval intersects it
termSelection.dates: House-owned dct:temporal/dcat:startDate/endDate only; no sitting inference

memberDateSelection.interval: mapped inclusive xsd:dateTime endpoints evaluated at calendar-day precision

memberCount.operation: count distinct Member RDF identities after the same validated scoped Member selection/evaluator as listing
memberCount.bound: all pages within existing limit/offset contract or fail closed
memberCount.qualification: recorded people, not constituency seats or election-event counts
memberCount.empty: A bounded explicit membership-date query may return recorded 0 only after complete valid execution with no uncertain or conflicting input; this is not a certified historical negative or evidence of a complete zero. An empty term-wide selection without a date point is unavailable, not zero.

latestRecordedMemberTerm.selection: all accepted Member-to-DailMembership-to-exact-DailTerm paths, then latest by House-owned start dates
latestRecordedMemberTerm.projection: the constituency linked to that exact latest DailTerm identity

relativeTerm.selection: One uniquely active Dáil at asOf and the unique immediately preceding term by House-owned start date; evaluate the complete typed DailTerm chronology, not Member-specific membership or labels.
relativeTerm.missingTiedConflictingOrOverlappingChron: Fail closed; do not break ties by IRI or omit undated terms.
